meta.title: [Blazor] Remove sourcemap link comments from production bundles for blazor.web.js and blazor.webassembly.js
meta.body_summary: Modify Rollup configuration to use sourcemap: 'hidden' for production blazor.web.js and blazor.webassembly.js, removing sourceMappingURL comments to reduce bundle size and improve security while preserving generated .map files.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot changed Rollup sourcemap config to 'hidden'; review caught unintended dependency version changes, reverted before merge.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: A trivially small change (13 lines across 3 files, net effect in one config file). This aligns with a low-risk, narrowly scoped performance/build improvement that merged after review reverted unintended collateral changes.

review_details.concern_detail: javiercn requested not to change @microsoft/dotnet-js-interop dependency version in package.json (from '*' to '^10.0.0-dev'); later lewing questioned leftover package-lock.json change. Both are unintended, so Copilot reverted them.
review_details.performance_claim: Removes sourceMappingURL comments from production bundles, reducing bundle size and improving security.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent successfully applied the build configuration change but introduced unintended dependency version modifications in adjacent files, requiring manual detection and fix directives from maintainers.

detection_detail.code_reading: javiercn and lewing reviewed the diff, spotted stray changes in package.json and package-lock.json, and directed Copilot to revert them.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after bundle size measurement; the claim of reduced size is narrative only.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Unintended changes were reverted in two commits: bf26c4af for package.json and 6d9e1e42 for package-lock.json.

core_change_summary.description: Changed sourcemap option to 'hidden' for production builds of blazor.web.js and blazor.webassembly.js in rollup.config.mjs, omitting sourceMappingURL comment while still generating .map files.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Unintended version changes in package.json and package-lock.json were introduced then reverted.
change_trajectory: Initial commit rolled the sourcemap change plus accidental dependency version bump.
Maintainer javiercn flagged the dependency change; Copilot reverted it in a follow-up commit.
Reviewer lewing noticed residual package-lock change; Copilot reverted it.
Final state: only rollup.config.mjs retains the sourcemap: 'hidden' modification.

review_signals.summary: Requested not to change @microsoft/dotnet-js-interop version from '*' to '^10.0.0-dev'.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot reverted package.json change in commit bf26c4af.

review_signals.summary: Approved but questioned if remaining package-lock change was intended.
Directed Copilot to also revert the package-lock.json change.
Told Copilot to get back to work after addressing changes.
Copilot acknowledged reverting package.json change and later package-lock.json change.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with sourcemap config change and unintended version bumps.
javiercn immediately flagged version change; Copilot reverted package.json.
After 5 days, lewing approved but questioned leftover package-lock change.
javiercn commanded Copilot to revert it; Copilot did.
All unintended changes reverted, PR merged.
